g.text: Fig. QF1 — fullness α: six guide points blended from the chord (α 0) to the curve (α 1)
P_i = (1 − α)·L_i + α·G_i for i = 1…4; P0 and P5 fixed. Pale dots are the six control points; the dark line is the quintic drawn as a six-span cubic chain.
This is the fixture in workbench/quintic-fullness.json: the extension's output at each α should match these points.
x right, y up, grid units. One scale per row across the five α values, so the shapes can be compared. κ at the span's two ends, in 1/grid units.
